nodes.label: Code Review Priority Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Order of importance: correct, safe, holds under load, tested, fast, lean. Lean code matters because every extra line must be read, tested, and maintained.

nodes.label: Smallest Complete Change Principle
nodes.rationale: The best code is the code never written. Solve the whole problem with the least new code without sacrificing security, error handling, or validation at trust boundaries.
